1. Arrest of American who has given $1m in aid to Palestine prompts fears of 'growing repression from Trump'. Extradition request for James 'Fergie' Chambers sparks concerns that US government is conflating humanitarian aid with terrorism. This was reported by The Guardian.

2. Israeli air attack on Gaza apartment kills family of three. One child survives hit on Deir el-Balah home as. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

5. Shoebridge criticises Labor for delayed AI policy - as it happened.
